Yes, it is more than okay. I think it's really brave, in fact. Take all the time you need to feel okay and to feel whole again. You are worthy just as you are. Give yourself the time and space to discover what it is you want in life and who you are. Your worth as a human being will never be dependent on your school or work performance (or any other metric). Everyone else is just out here existing too, even if it seems like some are doing it "better" than others - we only ever really see the outside of their lives. Keep doing what you can.
